segments.an9.44:1.2: Kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, paññāvimutto vutto bhagavatā”ti?
segments.an9.44:2.1: “Idhāvuso, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi … pe … paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, paññāya ca naṃ pajānāti.
segments.an9.44:2.3: Ettāvatāpi kho, āvuso, paññāvimutto vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena … pe ….
segments.an9.44:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati, paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti, paññāya ca naṃ pajānāti.
segments.an9.44:3.3: Ettāvatāpi kho, āvuso, paññāvimutto vutto bhagavatā nippariyāyenā”ti.

lines: Tatiye paññāya ca naṃ pajānātīti taṃ paṭhamajjhānavipassanāpaññāya jānāti.
Yathā ca idha, evaṃ ito paresupi.
